detail: The test asserts heroTitle 'Brand: Gravitator' after the tag click, but the page keeps its scroll offset, so the highlight frame shows the title cut off behind the sticky site header (only the lower half of the glyphs is visible). The case's main expectation, the exact header title, is never readable in the recording. Scroll to top (or scroll the title into view with the header offset) before demo.highlight(heroTitle). [raised by opus, sol]

The case expects both journeys to list the same product names on page 1 in the same order (9 items). The final highlight 'Same 9 products on page 1 in the same order' shows only 6 cards fully; the third row's names are below the fold. The filter journey shows only the first 3 names (frame 03). Per lesson L2, page 1's last card is never in view. Show the full 9-card grid (scroll/zoom, or caption the recorded name list) in each journey. [raised by opus, sol]

The nine-name array comparison is correct, and both journeys now show the last card and pager. However, their middle-row product names remain below the viewport; frame 11 only partially reveals those names at the bottom edge. None of the supplied frames shows all nine names readably across either journey. Capture each middle row or display each recorded ordered name list in readable captions.
